 Heavily threatened by relegation, the Timao are desperate to make up for points in this round, with the chance to qualify for Copa Sudamericana already gone. The struggle for the side now is to avoid relegation and remain in the league, come the end of the season.
 In the last five league appearances they have only taken four points — courtesy of one win, three losses and one stalemate. Currently, they are in the seventeenth league spot and need at least three wins to remain in the league next season.

 The Corinthian squad has had problems this season, with managers changed and the whole Memphis Depay contract saga. Clarence Seedorf is expected to keep the team from relegation, with only five matches left. Yuri Alberto leads the squad with the Cesar-Garro-Bidu combination behind him.

 São Paulo vs Corinthians Match Prediction 05 November, 2026
 The São-Paulo vs Corinthians match is always an explosive meeting with the two sides always trying to get the better of each other actively. Memphis Depay is missing from this match but the team looks to the combination of Bidu, Garro and Kaio Cesar to push their claim.
 The São Paulo side have home advantage and will bank on it as they look to pay Corinthian for the earlier league 3-2 win. Banking on set-piece opportunities and dead balls, they will also look to Luciano and Arthur to assist Jonathan Callieri in front.
 I expect both sides to find the back of the net, a possible win for the hosts and at least three goals in regulation time.
